contract: The fixed address 0x00FF7EDE is actor-table slot 2 plus offset 0x1A. Actor_TerrainCollisionLoop consumes and advances this residual-motion word; MovementVM actor-relative 0x83 and 0x90 commands are the indirect stream-level producers.
evidence_summary: The bounded MovementDecoder inventory found 24 exact actor-relative commands targeting +0x1A: one 0x83 word write of zero and 23 0x90 word additions/subtractions. The inventory covers all 85 layout-bounded MOVEMENT_STREAM ranges.
limitations: The fixed slot-two alias is a view onto the common actor table, so the commands are not separate writes to one permanently selected global address.
No runtime promotion is claimed for streams not observed on the captured route.
conclusion: ACTOR_SLOT_2_VERTICAL_MOTION no longer has a producer-unknown description; its indirect MovementVM producer encoding is now recorded while retaining the generic actor-relative field model.
